answer: The verifier hands the agent a quill seed and demands a sequential walk over 8 million cache lines across 32 GB of RAM, each step sealed with Blake3. Every step depends on the previous hash, so the walk cannot be parallelized, and the 12 second deadline fits only a machine holding the full shale array. One honest agent finishes in 11 seconds on its own hardware, while 10 fakes sharing one box must queue 320 GB of beacon reads and blow past the deadline.
